To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we fabricated the high efficiency HSCs by using the PEDOT: GQDs, PSi and TiOx, which can be a promising candidate for the practical applications of solar cells.
the PEDOT: GQDs PSi HSCs with the TiOx passivation layer exhibit the high performance and stability.
the PEDOT: GQDs/PSi/n Si/ TiOx hybrid solar cells with the TiOx passivation layer show the high performance and stability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of HSCs with high performance, high stability, and simple fabrication process.
the development of high efficiency and stability HSCs with PEDOT:GODS/PSi/n Si/TiOx structure.
the high-performance and long-term stability HSCs based on the GQDs mixed conducting polymer, PSi, and TiOx.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have successfully developed a new HSCs with high efficiency, stability and low cost.
the GQDs mixed PEDOT:PSi/n Si/TiOx HSCs with the high PCE of 10.4 and the high stability of 78% for 15 days is the first report.
the HSCs based on PEDOT:GODs/PSi/n Si/TiOx have high performance and stability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the GQDs mixed polymer is a promising candidate to enhance the conductivity, the passivated TiOx layer is a good candidate for the prevention of the recombination loss at Si back contact, and the formation of PSilayer is a good candidate to reduce the reflectivity of Si, and all together can enhance the performance of the HSCs.
the HSCs with PEDOT:GODs/PSi/TiOx/n Si are highly promising for the practical applications of low-cost, high-efficiency, and long-term stability.
the HSCs based on PEDOT:GODS/PSi/n-Si with a back passivation layer can be used as a low-cost alternative to conventional silicon solar cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PEDOT: GQDs/PSi/n Si/TiOx HSCs with a simple fabrication process can be a promising candidate for high efficiency and stability in the practical applications of HSCs.
the HSCs with the TiOx layer can provide a promising solution to enhance the stability of conducting polymer/PSi hybrid solar cells.
the HSCs with the PEDOT: GQDs and PSi hybrid structure are promising for the practical application.
